name: Polycon International Limited
about: Polycon International Limited engages in the manufacture and trade of PETS products in India. The company provides PET bottles, jars, and preforms; caps and lids; CPR open top rectangular tanks, PRLFT loft tanks, PHD household drums, CPVC industrial buckets and vats, and PS stools. It also offers LLDPE rotomoulding water storage tanks, PVC profiles, and sections. Polycon International Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Jaipur, India.
